note: LifeXP's own game Rush (docs/v2/PLAN.md 9.1, stage rr-a): the mode picker that is the game's first screen. Each mode is its own page next to it (wave-rush/, ship-rush/, flip-rush/) with its own progress and storage keys; they share the Rush engine in v2/public/games/_engine/. The picker only reads the modes' progress through their records. Its CSP is in index.html; tests/vendor-game.spec.js checks it like a vendored game's.
